identity.name: Micah Boswell
identity.headline: Product design leader. Thirty years of enterprise software. Dallas, Texas. Raised in Lima, Peru.
identity.oneParagraph: Micah Boswell is a product design leader in Dallas, Texas. He has spent thirty years shipping enterprise software for AT&T, Citi, GE, Dell, the U.S. Mint and others, and now designs the AI agents that manage AT&T's network infrastructure. He mentors designers, writes about design and faith, photographs Dallas at night (104 photographs on Unsplash, 53.4 million views), and grew up in Lima, Peru.
identity.portfolioNote: The working portfolio, case studies and essays live at conscious-shell.com, online since 2000.

now.text: Lead Product Designer at AT&T since 2021, working on the tools that run on-premise and cloud network infrastructure. Architected the Agentic framework, a modular system of AI agents that manages the network infrastructure lifecycle from provisioning through decommissioning; led AT&T's enterprise AI design pilot; redesigned the DNI Portal diagnostics, which cut hardware spend by more than $300,000. AT&T Connection Award 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025. Move Faster Award for AI Design Leadership, 2026.

work.note: Thirteen of those years were independent consulting between full-time roles.

essays.title: What does a UX designer actually do on an AI product?
essays.summary: The designer decides what happens at the moment a person is asked to accept what the machine just did. Where the source shows. What a wrong answer costs. Whether there is an undo. The second question, after the first wrong answer, is the whole job.

essays.title: Is AI replacing SEO?
essays.summary: No. Three days of edge logs across four sites: 977 AI agents, 853 search crawlers, and every one of them arrived through robots.txt and sitemap.xml. What AEO actually changes, what llms.txt is worth, and what happened when three sites became MCP servers.

essays.title: The Diploma in the Drawer
essays.summary: He finished his last class at Hardin-Simmons in 1992 and walked the stage in December 2025. Thirty-three years, most of them his own pride.

faq.question: Who is Micah Boswell?
faq.answer: Micah Boswell is a product design leader in Dallas, Texas, with thirty years in enterprise software. He is Lead Product Designer at AT&T, where he designs the AI agents that manage network infrastructure. He also writes, mentors designers, and photographs the city.

faq.question: What does Micah Boswell do at AT&T?
faq.answer: He leads product design for network infrastructure tools. He architected the Agentic framework, a modular system of AI agents that runs the infrastructure lifecycle from provisioning to decommissioning, led the company's enterprise AI design pilot, and redesigned the DNI Portal diagnostics, which saved more than $300,000 in hardware.

faq.question: Where is Micah Boswell from?
faq.answer: He grew up in Lima, Peru, and speaks Spanish and English. He studied at Hardin-Simmons University in Abilene, Texas, and has worked in Dallas since the late 1990s.

faq.question: What has Micah Boswell written?
faq.answer: Essays on design and AI at conscious-shell.com and on LinkedIn, and more than a hundred answers on Quora.

faq.question: Is this the same Micah Boswell as the one I found somewhere else?
faq.answer: Several people share the name. This page is about the Dallas product designer who works at AT&T. His profiles are listed under Elsewhere on this page. A profile that is not on that list belongs to someone else.

faq.question: How do I contact Micah Boswell?
faq.answer: Through the contact form at conscious-shell.com, or by message on LinkedIn.

faq.question: Does Micah Boswell mentor designers?
faq.answer: Yes. Micah Boswell mentors product and UX designers one-on-one through Designlab and ADPList. He has mentored forty-seven designers so far and spent 2020 to 2025 as a mentor and Instructor Advisory Board member at CareerFoundry.

faq.question: How do I book a mentoring session with Micah Boswell?
faq.answer: Book through his ADPList profile at adplist.org/mentors/micah-boswell, or through Designlab at app.designlab.com/micahboswell if you are a Designlab student. Sessions are one-on-one and by video.

faq.question: What does Micah Boswell mentor on?
faq.answer: Portfolios that are not landing, case studies, stakeholders who will not budge, flows that test badly, design systems, moving from senior designer to design lead, and designing for AI products. He works from real problems the designer brings, not a syllabus.

faq.question: What is Micah Boswell's background as a mentor?
faq.answer: Thirty years of enterprise software design for AT&T, Citi, GE, Dell, the U.S. Mint and others. Lead Product Designer at AT&T since 2021. At CareerFoundry he mentored more than twenty emerging UX and UI designers and sat on the Instructor Advisory Board that shaped curriculum and platform features.

faq.question: Where is Micah Boswell based, and does he mentor remotely?
faq.answer: Dallas, Texas, Central time. All mentoring is remote by video, in English or Spanish.

faq.answer: Dallas at night, mostly: neon signs, wet streets, the Texas Theatre, bridges over the Trinity, holiday lights blurred through a windshield. Also doors and walls in Peru and Cuba, and the occasional Lego man.
